newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash crops ease in wary market.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash crops ease in wary market.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat, soybean and sunseed prices slipped Friday in hesitant trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, dealers said.

"The market is very sensitive to movements in Chicago -- so much so that it bounces sometimes following technical movements there, and is largely ignoring the local problem of drought in central and northern crop areas," one trader said.
He said the dry spell was hurting some wheat fields and could delay sowing of maize and soybean.
Cash maize prices were firm, however, on strong supply.
